origin.rerun: grep -n 'if self.ask_opener' -A20 src/prop/platform/dxtrade.py -- open while an ask_opener=True path can reach TICKET_OPENER_NAMES / the row double-click after a non-click decline.

what: OA-04 (MED, prop order path, tradeify_1 live). Sub-agent read; the first half was re-checked by the lane at dxtrade.py:5637-5650. When the Ask-button opener declines WITHOUT clicking (e.g. one-click reads 'unknown'), open_order_ticket falls through to the later openers, including the watchlist row double-click (dxtrade.py ~5682-5704). That fallback is skipped only when one-click reads 'on'. If one-click is actually ON but reads 'unknown', a price-cell double-click can fire an instant, UNBRACKETED market order. Proposed fix (Tier-2): after the `if ask.get('clicked')` block, add `if self.ask_opener: out['refused'] = f"ask_button: {ask.get('why')}"; return out`. Also gate the last resort on a positive one-click OFF read, not on `!= 'on'`.
